title: tools/crypto2dev_status.c: CLI tool to query /dev/crypto2dev
description:
Userspace tool to query /dev/wolfcrypt module status.

Usage: wolfkm_status [--json]

Opens /dev/wolfcrypt, issues WOLFKM_IOC_STATUS ioctl, prints:
- FIPS state (0=not operational, 1=operational, numeric for other states)
- Number of registered algorithms
- wolfkm version string

Human-readable output:
  wolfkm v1.0 | FIPS: OPERATIONAL | algorithms: 24

JSON output (--json flag):
  {"fips_state":1,"num_algorithms":24,"version":"1.0"}

Exit code: 0 if FIPS OPERATIONAL, 1 if not operational, 2 on error.
design: Links only against libc. Include include/uapi/wolfkm_ioctl.h. Human-readable FIPS state strings: 0=UNKNOWN, 1=OPERATIONAL, 2=ERROR. Handle -ENOENT (device not present) and -EACCES (permission denied) with clear error messages. See DESIGN.md §tools.
